{{Quote|Don't lecture me, Jedi. My wife is dead! Our people, slaughtered! Where were you then?|Saylew|<ref name="High-Tech Savages" />}}
During the [[Flesh Raider uprising|conflict]] between the [[Flesh Raider]]s of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] and the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]<ref name="High-Tech Savages" /> in [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Time" /> a group of Flesh Raiders '''attacked''' the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Pilgrims|Pilgrim]] settlement of [[Kalikori village]].<ref name="High-Tech Savages" /> The Flesh Raiders had recently [[Attack on the Gnarls Outpost|attacked]] a nearby [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Gnarls Outpost|outpost]] before being [[Duel in the Gnarls cave|driven out of the area]],<ref name="Attack of the Flesh Raiders" /> and another group of Flesh Raiders chose to attack Kalikori after a [[Hero of Tython|young Jedi]] departed to [[Raid on the Flesh Raider weapons cache|retrieve]] a Flesh Raider weapons cache nearby for the villagers. During the attack, the [[Saylew's wife|wife]] of a villager named [[Saylew]] was [[Death/Legends|killed]] before the villagers could drive the Flesh Raiders away, and Saylew's grief drove him to interrupt a meeting between several Jedi and the village's [[Scout Chief]] [[Moorint]] while they were planning a [[Skirmish at the ancient shrine|scouting mission]].<ref name="High-Tech Savages" />

==Behind the scenes==
The attack was first mentioned in the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] class mission "High-Tech Savages" in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. It occurs during the events of the mission, and the player returns to find an angry Saylew in the village.<ref name="High-Tech Savages" />
